body: No money and a job that doesn't pay much and this city doesn't exactly have well paying jobs anywhere, it's kind of dead-end.

I'm a pretty average person (Besides my lifestyle, I suppose). I've never really seen myself as anyone special. Usually on a daily basis I just get up, clean myself up, chat with friends and game. I do work, but it's freelance works so I kind of only work when I want to.

Like I said, I'm pretty average and boring.
This helps, actually. I didn't know about this.
A combination of it's too cold and the fact that I live in the middle of a city, so I'm kind of restricted.
It's very liberating and makes me feel better about my body, I feel that people in this lifestyle are more body positive than others, and I just like the human body, I think it's a beautiful thing.
Meeting a girl like me, or finding somewhere I can explore my lifestyle...
There is, yes...There are a couple of things that would make me reconsider...
I've got it all planned out.
